title: Muratayak language
description: Finisterre language spoken in Papua New Guinea
extract: Muratayak, also Asat, is one of the Finisterre languages of Papua New Guinea. There is no overall name; speakers variously use Muratayak, Asat and Aset. These names do not correspond consistently to dialects or even specific villages.
